environment.description: Same Laravel 10.x application deployed on ECS Fargate behind CloudFront distribution. CloudFront response headers policy 'Managed-SecurityHeadersPolicy' (ID: 67f5ae08-44c8-4cd2-9e4e-9eb528d3669c) is attached to the distribution behavior, which injects Content-Security-Policy: script-src 'self'. Additionally, the ECS task definition includes a sidecar container running a custom OpenResty instance that appends X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and strips any inline event handlers. The CloudFront function at viewer-response stage also enforces frame-ancestors 'self' to prevent clickjacking of the redirect page. Note: the meta http-equiv refresh tag is NOT blocked by CSP script-src directives as it is not considered script execution.
